title: 每日剂量：放射肿瘤学中工作流集成的大语言模型自动化临床总结与试验识别
summary: 本文介绍了“每日剂量”（TDD）系统，这是一个集成到常规放射肿瘤学实践中的LLM驱动的自动化临床总结和临床试验识别系统。经过一个月的部署，对55名临床医生的调查显示，该系统具有良好的可用性、满意度和感知有用性，83.6%的用户每天或每周多次使用，27%的用户估计每天节省至少10分钟。
summary_en: This paper presents The Daily Dose (TDD), an LLM-driven automated clinical summarization and clinical-trial identification system integrated into routine radiation oncology practice. After one month of deployment, a survey of 55 clinicians showed good usability, satisfaction, and perceived usefulness, with 83.6% using it daily or several times per week and 27% estimating at least 10 minutes saved per day.
